question: Which Indian sprinter won both the 100 m and 200 m titles at the Indian Open Athletics 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Srabani Nanda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Srabani Nanda** is an accomplished Indian sprinter known for her expertise in short-distance running events such as the **100 meters** and **200 meters**.
 
• She achieved a remarkable feat by winning both the **100 m** and **200 m titles** at the **Indian Open Athletics 2025**.
 
• The Indian Open Athletics is a prestigious event conducted annually, showcasing the best talents in athletics from across the country.
 
• Srabani Nanda’s victory demonstrates her exceptional speed, endurance, and dedication to the sport, making her one of the top sprinters in India.
 
• Her performance in the competition was a testament to her rigorous training regime and ability to excel in both sprint categories.
 
• The competition featured several other skilled athletes, but Srabani Nanda stood out due to her consistent and outstanding performance.
 
• Her achievements contribute significantly to India’s athletics representation on the international stage, inspiring young athletes to pursue sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Srabani Nanda:**

 
 
• Srabani Nanda is an Indian sprinter from **Odisha**, known for her prowess in short-distance running.
 
• She has represented India in various international competitions, including the **Asian Games** and the **Olympics**.
 
• Her specialties include the **100 meters** and **200 meters** events, where she has consistently performed at a high level.
 
 
 
• **Indian Open Athletics:**
 
 
• The Indian Open Athletics is one of India’s key athletics competitions, providing a platform for athletes to showcase their talent at the national level.
 
• The event includes various categories such as sprint races, long-distance running, jumps, and throws.
 
• It serves as a qualifying event for international competitions, helping athletes gain recognition and further opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Other Competitors:**
 
 
• **Archana Suseendran:** An Indian sprinter who specializes in 100 m and 200 m events, she is known for her speed and competitive spirit.
 
• **Hima Das:** Nicknamed the “Dhing Express,” Hima Das is a celebrated Indian sprinter famous for winning gold at the **IAAF World U20 Championships** in 2018.
 
• **Dutee Chand:** An internationally recognized Indian athlete, Dutee Chand specializes in short-distance sprints and has represented India in several global events.

• **Key Achievements of Srabani Nanda:**

 
 
• She has competed in the **2016 Rio Olympics** in the 200 m event, representing India on the global stage.
 
• She has also won medals at the **South Asian Games**, further solidifying her position as a top sprinter in India.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Sprinting Events:**
 
 
• Sprinting events, such as the **100 m** and **200 m**, require explosive power and speed, making them some of the most exciting events in athletics.
 
• Indian athletes have been making significant progress in sprinting, gaining international recognition and inspiring upcoming generations.
